title: Live Clock Starts a Row Query
statement: For every $l,N,j\in\mathbb{N}$, every $pos,neg\in\text{Fin}(l)$, input word, row, target words, stream, cursor, and flag word, if $j<N$, one step of the matcher from its initial search control enters the row-loading control at counter zero with the fresh-loader state. The row, target words, stream, cursor, clock position, and flags are unchanged.
replaced: For every search seam with query-clock position $j < N$, one matcher step reads the live clock token and dispatches to the row-loading phase; no source-time bookkeeping, stream bit, or stored flag changes.
